# Method GetStyles

#### GetStyles(DocumentId)

Fetch styles from drafting documents.

##### Declaration

```
[OperationContract]
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 20, 255, 0)]
List<ElementId> GetStyles(DocumentId inDocumentId)
```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- | 
   
|  DocumentId |  inDocumentId |  Drafting document to study  |  

##### Returns

|  Type |  Description |  
| --- | --- | 
   
|  List<ElementId> |  Styles inside drafting document as a list.  |  

##### Remarks

This interface is available since v7.20.
